game_title: Guess Until Right – Stalactite Hall Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall, a hall of dripping stalactites: the lantern keeper must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall: a hall of dripping stalactites
core_gameplay_loop: In Stalactite Hall, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round, slime blobs strike the cave gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cave gate from slime blobs in Stalactite Hall: keep the guess_range meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: guess_range drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Stalactite Hall'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Stalactite Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while guess_range > 0.
